name: Canon Quality Score (Canon Score)
status: Structured ranking tool, partly subjective, combining business quality, governance, tradability and price. Not a measure of intrinsic value, a return forecast or a probability of success. Weights, thresholds and overrides are author judgement. No out-of-sample record for v1.4; written after seeing 2021 bank data.
applies_to: Scores made on or after 2026-11-22. Never applied retroactively to version 1.2 scores or to the 1.2-P forward record.

conventions.boundary: Rows saying 'or higher', 'or more', 'at least', 'or below', 'or less' or 'up to' include the boundary. Otherwise a boundary value belongs to the range that starts at it, else the range that ends at it. 'Above'/'below' exclude the boundary.
conventions.two_rows: If a company fits two rows for any other reason, take the lower score.
conventions.aggregation: Sum of seven dimension scores (0-100); never averaged.
conventions.price_dependence: Dimensions 3 and 4 depend on the share price and trading; record the price date with every score.
conventions.record: Record rubric version, data cut-off date and share-price date with every score.
conventions.year_counting: A five-year growth record = five year-on-year comparisons from six consecutive annual figures (profit, revenue, loans, deposits, EPS). 'Grew' = higher than the year before. Five-year dividend record = dividends declared for five financial years. Three-year average ROE = three annual ROEs from four year-end balance sheets.
conventions.missing_data: Not applicable: follow the table's own rule; not counted as missing. Unavailable / unverified ('not verified'): no higher than the middle row (lower of two middle rows when even) unless the table sets its own limit. Estimated: score normally, label 'estimated'. Unavailable + unverified + estimated > 20 points -> total 'provisional'.
conventions.big_swing: Year-on-year change > 50% up or down; any change into or out of a loss counts as a big swing. Moderate = none; very volatile / erratic = two or more in five years.
conventions.point_changes: 'Deduct N points' subtracts from the table score, floor 0. 'Drop one row' moves to the next lower row; the lowest row stays. Every table covers every company; if none fits, score the lower of the two nearest rows and report the gap.

sub.name: 3-year average ROE
sub.definition: Each year: profit attributable to owners of the parent / average equity attributable to owners of the parent ((opening+closing)/2). Use consolidated accounts whenever published (excluding non-controlling interests from both lines); otherwise standalone. Simple average of the three annual ROEs. Report all three annual ROEs. Zero or negative equity at any year-end: score 1.
bands: 15%+ with no year below 10%
10%-15%; or 15%+ with a year below 10%; no loss year
7%-10%, no loss year
below 7%, or a loss (negative ROE) in any of the last 3 years, whatever the average

sub.name: Regulatory capital cushion (BFIs)
sub.definition: Total CAR above the NRB total-capital minimum for the class and level, at the latest quarter-end. Commercial banks (CAF 2015): CET1 4.5%, Tier 1 6%, total 8.5%, plus 2.5-point conservation buffer in CET1 -> 7% / 8.5% / 11%; missing any component = below minimum. Counter-cyclical buffer 0-2.5%: 0.5% required by mid-July 2024, then 0% for FY 2081/82 (reported Aug 2024); check the current rate. Other classes per NRB Financial Stability Report FY 2023/24 (mid-July 2024): development banks other than national-level 11% total / 8.5% core; national-level development banks 10% / 6%; finance companies 10% / 6%; microfinance 8% capital fund / 4% core (simpler framework, not directly comparable). A newer Unified Directive (reported as 2082) may restate these; use it when read. Applicable minimum undetermined: 'unverified', max 5. Not a complete solvency measure.
bands: 2 points or more above class minimum
0.5 to 2 points above
0 to 0.5 points above
below minimum at latest quarter-end (also hard cap 54)
sub.past_breach: Below minimum at any quarter-end in last 3 years but above now: max 3.

sub.name: Leverage (non-financial companies) = debt-to-equity (3) + interest cover (4)

parts.name: debt-to-equity
bands: below 1.0x
above 3.0x, or zero or negative equity

parts.name: interest cover
bands: above 5x, or no interest-bearing debt
3x-5x
below 1.5x, or operating loss

sub.note: Debt maturity recorded, not scored. Chapter 65 has no sector version yet; compare hydropower only with hydropower.
cases: debt with little or no expensed interest (capitalised interest): use all interest incurred

sub.name: Earnings quality: five year-on-year profit comparisons (six annual figures)
bands: no loss year; profit grew in at least 4 of 5 comparisons
no loss year; flat or declining in exactly 2
no loss year, flat or declining in 3+; or exactly one loss year
two or more loss years, or erratic
adjustments: Non-financial: cash conversion ratio = sum of 3-year operating cash flow / sum of 3-year net profit; below 0.5 -> deduct 1 point (floor 0). Not applied if 3-year net profit <= 0.
Lenders: if in any of the last 3 years more than 25% of net profit came from provision write-backs or one-off gains -> deduct 1 point.

sub.name: Promoter holding stability and pledging (3 years)
bands: stable or rising; under 10% pledged
broadly stable; 10%-25% pledged
falling without stated reason, or 25%-50% pledged
falling sharply without stated reason, more than 50% pledged, or repeated insider selling
source_order: company share register / annual report shareholding note
sub.explained_falls: Falls from mergers, legally required sales or new public issues are not penalised; only unexplained or repeated falls count.
sub.missing_data: Pledging not verified: at most 4 of 6.

measures.stable: promoter % of all shares changed < 1 point over 3 years (explained changes excluded)
measures.repeated_insider_selling: unexplained promoter/director sales in at least 2 of last 3 years
measures.rights: promoters not taking up rights: fall counts

sub.name: Audit opinion and related-party dealings
bands: clean opinion; small, fully disclosed RPT
clean opinion with emphasis of matter (not going concern)
prior-year restatement, or large but disclosed RPT
qualified opinion on a limited, explained matter
qualified on loans, provisions or RPT; scope limitation on a material area; or going-concern material uncertainty
adverse opinion, disclaimer, or undisclosed RPT found
sub.terms: Use the auditor report headings: emphasis of matter; material uncertainty related to going concern; qualified; adverse; disclaimer.

sub.name: Disclosure and board structure
sub.legal_minimum: Banks and financial institutions: BAFIA 2073 s14 - board of 5 to 7, at least 1 director under s14(3) ('independent director' in the Law Commission English text; 'professional director' in another translation). Other public companies: Companies Act 2063 s86(2) board of 3 to 11 (verified); s86(3) at least 1 independent director on a board of up to 7, 2 on a larger board (two agreeing legal publishers; sub-section text not read).
bands: all quarterly reports and AGM on time for 3 years, and more independent directors than legal minimum
on time with exactly the minimum, or independence not verified
repeated late filings, or below the legal minimum
penalised by SEBON or NEPSE for disclosure failure in last 3 years
sub.top_row_extra: Each independent director meets legal independence tests, attended >= 75% of board meetings in last year, audit committee includes one; unverified -> 3. Structural test only. Measures structure and filing discipline, not board effectiveness.

dimensions.name: Liquidity & Tradability

sub.name: Average daily turnover, 6 months
sub.definition: Total value traded over 6 months / number of NEPSE trading days, including zero-trade days.
bands: Rs 5 million+
Rs 1-5 million
Rs 0.2-1 million
below Rs 0.2 million
adjustments: Thin trading: traded on fewer than half of trading days -> at most 1.

sub.name: Free float
bands: below 10%
sub.definition: Share of outstanding shares genuinely available for ordinary trading: excludes promoter/founder, government and other strategic holdings, cross-holdings, locked-in shares, restricted employee/management shares and other restricted holdings (categories as in SEBON working paper on benchmark index restructuring, Asoj 30 2083 / 16 Oct 2026, a consultation draft). If restricted holdings cannot all be identified: public holding minus disclosed locked-in shares, marked 'estimated'.

dimensions.note: Preliminary tradability screen only. Circuit-hit frequency, post-halt price gaps and bunching of turnover are not scored; order-size feasibility via Chapter 56 ADV rule, circuit risk via Chapter 58.

dimensions.name: Valuation Reasonableness

sub.name: P/E vs sector median
bands: 0.8x or below (needs ROE >= sector median ROE, else 6)
above 1.5x, or operating loss over last 12 months

sub.name: P/B vs sector median
bands: 0.8x or below (needs ROE >= sector median ROE, else 5)
above 1.5x, or negative book value

dimensions.sector_median: NEPSE sector groups, comparable companies only (hydropower: operating plants); same price date; book values and earnings from the same latest published quarter and accounting basis. P/E median: exclude companies with a trailing 12-month loss; TTM EPS. P/B median: include loss-makers with positive book value; exclude zero/negative book. Each median needs at least 5 companies of its own, else 'unverified' and in-line row. Simple median; record price date.
dimensions.note: P/E and P/B move with the same price: read as one view. Company's own 5-year median is a cross-check only.
dimensions.no_earnings_rule: Pre-COD hydropower (no meaningful earnings): P/E not applicable; valuation = P/B points / 7 x 15, rounded; labelled 'one measure only'. ROE gate cannot be passed, so max 11. P/E 'not applicable' does not count towards the provisional limit.
dimensions.discount_gate: Top P/E or P/B row needs ROE >= sector median ROE; for lenders also NPL ratio <= system average.
dimensions.cross_checks: Recorded, not scored: own 5-year median; absolute P/E and P/B.

sub.name: Moat
bands: high barriers and evidence: ROE >= sector median in at least 4 of last 5 years (lenders: NPL <= system average); hydropower: operating plant delivering >= 90% of contracted energy in 2 of last 3 years with >= 10 years left on PPA
moderate barriers, or licence/regulated position without proof
low barriers; commodity-like
structural regulatory or technological threat

sub.name: Business and counterparty concentration
bands: 20% or less
above 60%
sub.definition: Largest single exposure. Non-financial: max of one customer's share of revenue, one segment/product's share of revenue, one region's share of revenue, one supplier's share of purchases. Lenders: credit concentration = largest share of loan book in one sector, segment or region (label 'credit concentration'). Denominators: revenue for customer/segment/region, purchases for supplier; record which exposure was largest. Lenders: single-borrower/connected-group exposure recorded, not scored.
sub.hydropower: Single-buyer NEA PPA scores 0 as a provisional penalty; hydropower totals not comparable across sectors until Chapter 65 sets a table (offtaker credit, payment delays/receivables, PPA length and enforceability, transmission, curtailment and deemed energy, tariff/regulation).

sub.name: 5-year revenue CAGR (non-lenders)
sub.definition: Operating revenue only; exclude one-off, revaluation and non-operating income. Merger/acquisition in period: use combined figures, else at most 6 and note 'merger'. CAGR = (revenue_t / revenue_t-5)^(1/5) - 1 from six annual figures.
bands: 15%+ and revenue grew in at least 4 of 5 comparisons
8%-15%; or 15%+ with growth in fewer than 4 of 5
negative, or very volatile
sub.zero_start: If revenue 5 years ago was zero or from less than a full year of operation: CAGR not used; 3 if revenue grew in at least 3 of last 4 years, else 0.

sub.name: Relative loan-growth discipline (lenders)
sub.rationale: Lender income is mainly interest, which moves with rates as well as lending; the loan book is the better measure of expansion.
bands: 5 percentage points or less faster or slower than the system
5-10 points faster or slower
more than 10 points faster or slower, or shrinking while system grows
adjustment_order: 1. Credit peak (book's working definition: system credit growth > 20% or system CD ratio within 5 points of ceiling) and lender > 5 points faster than system: 0, stop.
2. Loans > 5 points faster than deposits: drop one row.

3. Gross NPL ratio at same quarter-end vs same-class average, with write-offs during the year added back before comparing with a year earlier: above average and higher -> drop one row; or restructured/rescheduled loans > 5% of loans -> drop one row (one drop at most for this step). Steps 2-3 cannot take score below 2.
4. No verified system figure for same period: at most 5.
sub.measurement: Five-year CAGR of gross loans and advances for the lender and its class system over the same six year-ends; deposits measured the same way. Systems: commercial banks, development banks, finance companies, microfinance.
sub.adjusted_npl: (NPLs + loans written off in the year) / (total loans + loans written off in the year), gross, same quarter-end as the class average.

sub.name: EPS on a comparable share count: five year-on-year comparisons
sub.definition: Weighted average ordinary shares. Under NFRS (NAS 33, mirroring IAS 33; older 2008 standard NAS 26) each report restates the previous year for bonus issues and the bonus element of rights issues. For each year take EPS from the latest report showing it; adjust only for issues after that report. Bonus: divide by (1 + ratio). Rights: TERP = (old shares x market price + new shares x issue price) / (old + new); divide earlier EPS by market price / TERP. Unclear: rebuild from net profit and weighted shares. Expect an EPS dip in a rights-issue year.
bands: rose in at least 4 of 5 years, no big swing
rose in 3 of 5 years, at most one big swing
rose in 2 of 5 years, or very volatile
rose in fewer than 2 years, or negative in 3+ years
sub.loss_rule: A year counts as 'rose' only if EPS positive that year. Negative EPS in latest year or in 2+ of 5 years: max 2.

dimensions.name: Dividend & Capital Return Discipline

sub.name: Consistency, 5 years
sub.definition: A year counts as paid only with a real cash dividend (not tax-only cash on a bonus). Cash payout ratio = cash dividends / distributable profit; 30%-70% is a design preference. Bonus capitalisation ratio = bonus face value / distributable profit, recorded separately; not treated as equivalent to cash.
bands: real cash every year, cash payout within 30%-70% in at least 4 of 5 years
real cash in 4 of 5 years; or every year with payout outside 30%-70% in 2+ years
real cash in 2-3 of 5 years
real cash in 0-1 of 5 years
sub.distributable_profit: From the profit-appropriation statement or statement of changes in equity, not headline net profit. Lenders: NRB-format figure; BAFIA 2073 s44 requires at least 20% of net profit to the general reserve until the reserve equals twice paid-up capital, then at least 10% (checked against Nepali text); plus regulatory reserve and CSR fund.

sub.name: Source and purpose
bands: genuine distributable profit; reserves intact or growing; any bonus tied to stated capital need
partly one-off or revaluation gains, or bonus with no stated use
drawn from capital or reserves

dimensions.retained_by_design: Hydropower before COD, or bank/insurer barred from paying by regulator capital rules: consistency 4/6, source 2/4, marked 'retained by design'.
dimensions.recorded_not_scored: Return on retained capital = 5-year rise in EPS / total EPS retained (not paid in cash), all on a comparable share count.

score_bands: Exceptional; core holding up to 6%-8% of equity sleeve

triggers: pledging check 0 of 6 (>50% pledged, unexplained sharp fall, or repeated unexplained insider selling)
audit check 1 or less of 5 (qualified on loans/provisions/RPT, material scope limitation, going-concern material uncertainty, adverse, disclaimer, undisclosed RPT)

exclude: court or regulator finding of fraud by management or controlling shareholders
provisional: accounts materially restated (until a full year of new audited figures)
hard_limits.duration: Caps apply only while the flag is current: audit = latest audited annual report; pledging = latest disclosed figure; unexplained promoter falls count for the 3-year look-back.

known_overlaps: About 25-30 of 100 points rest directly or indirectly on reported profit (ROE, earnings quality, EPS growth, dividend consistency, ROE gate on valuation).
comparability: Compare totals within a sector; cross-sector comparability is a design aim, not tested.
still_judgement: grouping customers, products and regions in concentration
hydropower single-buyer concentration until Chapter 65 sets a sector table

items: one home dimension per indicator to limit double counting
growth judged by return on new capital
compare weights with simple alternatives such as equal weights
double-counting diagnostic: correlation of sub-scores, leave-one-dimension-out ranking changes, equal-weight comparison (Chapter 80 audit)
lender valuation using asset quality and cost of equity
duration and severity of past capital breaches
board effectiveness from documents (RPT approvals and terms, board challenge, auditor independence/rotation, audit follow-up, minority treatment, capital allocation)
lender capital quality and stress tests

test_protocol: whole sector incl. merged, failed, delisted
rank correlation overall and within sector
value beyond simple measures (ROE, P/B, leverage)
score stability to small data revisions
benchmarks: NEPSE index and sector index
market phases incl. credit stress; annual return, volatility, Sharpe ratio, downside deviation, turnover
correlation table and principal-component analysis of sub-scores
independent replication on a separate period

edge_cases: Kanchan Cement (invented): leverage 1+1=2/7; cash conversion 0.45 -> earnings quality 5-1=4
Tamor Khola Hydro (invented, pre-COD): valuation 5/7 x 15 = 11, one measure only; dividends retained by design 4+2
Sagarmatha Growth Bank (invented): ROE 8/8; write-backs 30% of profit -> -1; NPL 5.1% vs 4.0% rising -> drop a row; 55% pledged -> override cap 54
assumptions_marked: adjusted NPL 3.1% vs 3.4% a year earlier, class average 4.0%
reserves grew every year; distributions met NRB conditions

history: closed table gaps and overlaps, bonus-adjusted EPS, severe-red-flag override trigger with cap 54, aligned bands with Ch66, capped unverified pledging
lender loan growth vs system with credit-peak cap and funding check; valuation discount needs ROE >= sector median

complete scoring rules for steps left to judgement in 1.2; CAR vs class minimum; ROE, ADV, swing definitions; cash and thin-trading checks; lender asset-quality step and adjustment order; EPS per NFRS/IAS 33 incl. rights bonus element; real-cash dividend rule; sector-median and loss-maker rules; licence alone not full moat; pledge source order; extra hard limits. Weights and bands unchanged.

technical patch: P/B scaling for no-earnings companies (no double count); leverage split D/E 3 + cover 4; business and counterparty concentration with zero row (credit concentration for lenders); full free-float definition; deduction rules; cash conversion ratio; lender profit check; consolidated ROE alignment; past CAR breach max 3; measurable promoter falls; board effectiveness tests; gross NPL with write-offs added back and restructured loans; EPS loss rule; cash-only payout with bonus recorded separately; return on retained capital recorded; three reported outputs; position limits labelled provisional. Weights and score bands unchanged.

technical corrections (see patch list in Chapter 64): ROE loss-year rule; P/B median peer set; profit-record row order; boundary, year-counting, missing-data and swing definitions; zero equity and capitalised interest; capital table by class with dates; CCyB history; adjusted NPL formula; loan/deposit CAGR; NAS 33 restatement; hydropower comparability; HUBL evidence. Weights and bands unchanged.

outputs.rule: Always report all three; never the total alone.

score_bands_note: Position limits attached to bands are provisional ceilings, not evidence-based sizes; Chapter 60/66 concentration limits, maximum tolerable loss and Chapter 56 ADV rule also apply.
forward_pilot_note: The 1.2-P pilot (frozen 2026-11-17) cannot validate v1.4; its 2027-11 review is a first-year look only.
patch_scope: Technical corrections only: no weight, band or new scored measure changed. Only published score under 1.4: HUBL 87 (unchanged).
